title: Multi-Context Fusion Transformer for Pedestrian Crossing Intention Prediction in Urban Environments
abstract: arXiv:2511.20011v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Pedestrian crossing intention prediction is essential for autonomous vehicles to improve pedestrian safety and reduce traffic accidents. However, accurate pedestrian intention prediction in urban environments remains challenging due to the multitude of factors affecting pedestrian behavior. In this paper, we propose a multi-context fusion Transformer (MFT) that leverages diverse numerical contextual attributes across four key dimensions, encompassing pedestrian behavior context, environmental context, pedestrian localization context and vehicle motion context, to enable accurate pedestrian intention prediction. MFT employs a progressive fusion strategy, where mutual intra-context attention enables reciprocal interactions within each context, thereby facilitating feature sequence fusion and yielding a context token as a context-specific representation. translated_title: 城市环境中行人过街意图预测的多上下文融合Transformer
translated_abstract: 行人过街意图预测对于自动驾驶汽车提升行人安全、减少交通事故至关重要。然而，由于影响行人行为的因素众多，城市环境中的准确行人意图预测仍具挑战性。本文提出了一种多上下文融合Transformer（MFT），它利用四个关键维度的多样化数值上下文属性，包括行人行为上下文、环境上下文、行人定位上下文和车辆运动上下文，以实现准确的行人意图预测。MFT采用渐进式融合策略，其中上下文内互注意力使每个上下文内部能够相互交互，从而促进特征序列融合，并生成上下文令牌作为特定上下文的表示。随后，上下文间互注意力整合这些特征。
tldr: 本文提出了一种多上下文融合Transformer（MFT），通过渐进式融合策略整合行人行为、环境、定位和车辆运动四类上下文信息，实现城市环境中更准确的行人过街意图预测。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a Multi-Context Fusion Transformer (MFT) that progressively integrates four types of contextual information—pedestrian behavior, environment, localization, and vehicle motion—to achieve more accurate pedestrian crossing intention prediction in urban environments.
